column1: # panvar genotype: development performance configuration, version 1 (P1 consolidated baseline)
# Enables the reviewed, exact performance backends of the I1-I4 work with every value explicit.
#   - NOT a public default: the defaults are unchanged and this file is opt-in (--profile).
#   - NOT a validated production configuration. Its cache and capacity values come from the C4 v6 campaign
#     profile and the I-series development cells (C4, CYP2D6, ACOT); they are not universally validated.
#   - It carries NO scientific or model setting. The analysis's own settings (preset, base profile, curation,
#     library, dosage mode) and any operational override come from the comparison. Compose them with
#     tests/analysis/p1/compose_profile.py, which refuses duplicate keys and records every input.
# Every backend below is exact: completed results equal the reference backend's (the default value, shown in each
# comment). The caches and capacities change what is executed and stored, and so can change WHETHER a run completes
# under a cap, time limit or footprint limit (caps count executed work). They never change a completed result.
profile
## performance backend choices (default = the reference backend) ------------------------------------------------------
union_scoring_backend
# I2-A, default reference: indexed shared-content union scoring, with I1-I1.4 discovery, prefilter cache, origin reuse
# and retained incremental scoring.
adaptive_window_discovery
# I2-B, default reference: fine discovery in the adaptive search's window enumeration.
indexed_union_store_layout
# I2-C, default exact (stated explicitly).
indexed_union_evidence_layout
# I4-B, default reconstructed: factorised placement views over fine units.
adaptive_fused_seed
# I2-D, default 0: anchor scores and censuses in one placement pass.
marker_proposal_reuse_table_bytes
# I2-E, default 0 (off): exact marker-proposal contribution reuse, through a table of this size.
combination_prepared_library_terms
# I2-F, default 0: library terms prepared once per combination call (union and adaptive; dosage keeps the scalar path).
gap_recursion_backend
# I2-H, default scaled_reference: the fixed-geometry gapped recursion, bit-identical to the scaled reference.
dosage_census_backend
# I2-J, default reference: the interned dosage block census.
indexed_union_store_bytes
# I2-A/I2-C: the indexed union placement store (charged by capacity).
adaptive_fine_store_bytes
# I2-B: the round-local fine store, per adaptive search.
emission_cache_bytes
repair_origin_cache_bytes
union_placement_cache_bytes
union_origin_cache_bytes
union_prefilter_cache_bytes
start_sort_scratch_bytes
# The six caches and scratch above predate the I-series and exist in the production caller (C4 v6 campaign values).
## resource capacities and guards (consumption caps; they bound executed work and can refuse a run) -------------------
adaptive_fine_max_served_placements
max_union_cached_placements_consumed
max_union_cached_origins_consumed
max_union_cached_states_consumed
max_union_cached_prefilters_consumed
# Time limit, footprint limit, state-class and neighbour caps are NOT set here. They belong to the analysis's base
# profile, or are declared as operational overrides by the comparison (for example the 4 GiB local test envelope).
timing_detail
## parked mechanisms, left off: not set here, so they stay at their default (off) ---------------------------------------
# adaptive_emission_handoff (I2-K, default 0); repair_tie_seed_cache_bytes (default 0). The fine-origin aggregates
# (I4-E), page release (I4-G), diagnostic censuses (I2-I, I4-D) and certified pruning (I5) are not in this baseline.
